prompt: Round 5 of 6. The researcher side proposes (We accept 18 months exclusivity in the agreed product field as a trade. We want university ownership with an option

content.text:
The researcher is holding firm on uni_owns_option_to_licence. We've already conceded on exclusivity (18 months) and review days (60). The key question is whether uni_owns_option_to_licence is acceptable for FreshPak.

With an option to licence, FreshPak can exercise the option and get a licence. This should be workable for commercialisation - we can get an exclusive licence in our field. The 2028 deadline can still be met. I should accept this as it meets our core needs: we can commercialise the result, we have 18 months exclusivity, 60-day review, and the milestones are solid.
I'll accept this term.
